newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslav Feb '97 wages rise 12.5 pct to 695 dinars.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslav Feb '97 wages rise 12.5 pct to 695 dinars.

text.p: reported the following economic indicator details.
YUGOSLAV AVERAGE NET WAGES FEB 97 JAN 97 FEB 96
NOTES - Year-on-year February wages were 59 percent up in nominal terms and 16.7 percent up in real terms against the same month in 1996.

Based on new methodology of calculating average wages introduced in January 1997, data include all employed who worked in a given month, regardless of whether they all received wages earned in that month.
Data do not include private sector. Data cover Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305
